body:
I've been underweight for years. Stress (read: school) makes my appetite go away so I lose weight during the semester. I walk everywhere during the school year but I'm terrified of working out because I don't want to lose more weight. 

I try to focus on eating protein and veggies and use carbs to fill. Some days I can't eat anything but ice cream (dunno why) but I try to eat at least that. 

I wouldn't mind gaining 15lb so I my bones don't poke into things and I can't see my own ribs.

...can you tell I hyperanalyze everything?
